## What this adds

<!-- One or two sentences. For a skill: what situation it covers and where it came from. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (registry, validation, tests)
- [ ] `registry.json` is regenerated and committed

**If this adds or edits a skill:**

- [ ] The `description` says **when** to use it, not what it is
- [ ] The body is under the token budget; depth lives in `reference/`
- [ ] It contains something specific — a real command, a real number, a real failure
- [ ] It has a **Red flags** table, or it genuinely doesn't need one
- [ ] I set `author:` if I want the credit (optional)
